ShortDescription.Value: Talk to an in-game AI. It can zone, build roads, place services, and handle city problems. Add an API key in the mod settings. No other program required.

Publish.LongDescription:
Talk to AI in Cities: Skylines II. The AI reviews the city and carries out construction.
## Features
The AI can:
* Review demand and problems, and handle sewage, water, electricity, garbage, and missing road access first * Zone along roads (residential, commercial, industrial, office) * Build roads and connect water, sewage, and electricity * Place public buildings such as schools, hospitals, fire stations, police stations, power plants, water facilities, and garbage facilities * Buy tiles, adjust taxes and service budgets, and add transit lines
The player controls simulation speed. The AI can advance time for a while to observe construction results, then restore the previous speed. Demolition and Development Points are off by default and can be enabled in the mod settings.
## Setup
* Subscribe to and enable the mod * Enter the endpoint, API key, and model in the mod settings * After loading a city, use the chat at the bottom-right
Bring your own model and API key. No other program is required.
## Models
DeepSeek V4.1 and Muse Spark 1.3 are the models tested so far. Please try the mod, and try other models as well.
Report problems in the comments, or on GitHub: https://github.com/lulu0119/airimayor
